verdict.rationale: Notion's own docs describe built-in agents that keep work moving 24/7. Custom Agents can be started via chat sessions, return streamed replies, and take actions, which shows a first-party AI assistant that users can hand work to. The in-product delegation experience itself is thinly evidenced, mostly through marketing taglines and agent API docs. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on delegating tasks to the assistant inside the Notion UI, scope of tasks the agent can complete autonomously, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use sessions to start a chat, stream the Agent's reply, submit an action when needed, and read its event history.
